source_text: Cum bucina et lagenis et lampadibus hostes terga vertunt. Clamor: Gladius Domini et Gedeon. Optemus adscribi trecentis. Rufini novem homiliae in Iudicum completae. Gloria Patri et Filio et Spiritui Sancto in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: With trumpet and jars and lamps enemies backs turn. Shout: Sword of-Lord and Gideon. Let-us-wish to-be-enrolled to-three-hundred. Of-Rufinus nine homilies unto Judges completed. Glory to-Father and Son and Spirit Holy into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[With trumpet, jars, and lamps the enemies turn their backs >> Bible:Judges 7:16-22]]. The shout: Sword of the Lord and of Gideon. May we be enrolled among the three hundred. Rufinus’s nine Judges homilies are complete. Glory to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit forever. Amen.
notes: True OET; no copyrighted Judges FOTC.
